'''Station Guardian Two''' was a prototype [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] that was under development by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] after the destruction of [[Station Guardian One]] in the [[Battle of Kuat (Galactic War)|Battle for Kuat]] in the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Slicing|Guarding the Guardian}}</ref>
